subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw expose native sub-agent completion routing as `announceTarget` on `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, fold this into a broader A2A handoff contract, or keep the current depth/activity-based behavior without a new public option?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-backed, but the fix adds public tool/config surface and overlaps open structured handoff, skip/no-reply, and announce-suppression issues, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Sponsor native announceTarget
options.body: Add `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a backward-compatible native subagent tool/config contract with channel as the default and parent injection as an explicit mode.

options.title: Fold Into A2A Handoff Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as acceptance coverage while maintainers design one combined structured handoff API covering skip/no-reply, thread inheritance, and parent routing.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Decline a new public option and document current active-parent wake, channel delivery, and callback workarounds as the supported model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native announceTarget
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a backward-compatible native subagent tool/config contract with channel as the default and parent injection as an explicit mode.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the sessions_spawn/subagent announce surface and is the strongest routing owner in the available history.
